content.text:
I've set the RFx to go to all five vendors (V01–V05) for the three priority lines (RM-008, RM-009, RM-010), with the questionnaire attached. I added a pricing-breakdown question and a term requiring traders to name the manufacturing site.

Two things are still open before this can go out:
- **Response due date:** what date do you want vendors to reply by? Working back from the 20 December 2026 first need-by, I'd suggest a date that leaves time for sample CoAs and qualification.

Also, the other seven ingredients (RM-001 to RM-007) are not in this RFx. Should I add them to the same RFx, or send them as a separate one?
